<h2 class="section-title">India Markets</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>FII sentiment shift:</strong> Foreign institutional investors turned net buyers in July, injecting Rs 20,200 crore into Indian equities, marking a significant reversal after four months of sustained selling.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiygFBVV95cUxQSk95Vm1Ocmx2Z1lpb0VOZEFhNTlLQUx4c1BFUDYzLUdDM2I2QzB0MHNtdk1VTTlRX2pEZ2xkMlk4QlFtNnFCdS1YbC1SWFhic2lYeEp1UHlVYkF1bmdwSGJkeDJmTlNNS2ROeUZFYnJwNXdKNkRaM2tVVlJnZTlQZW1kSjQzSF9iRGxRZXN6dkZLcE9WcWQzdTJFZkVkYk9kUTJJNUtjbkFMMk5SX2RjRjZFWFJSN0ZUdWdva0pQZmxzeExfdzlWOFdB?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I2</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I3</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Institutional ownership trends:</strong> Domestic institutional investors (DIIs) have reached a record 21% ownership stake in Nifty 500 companies, surpassing FII holdings which have moderated to 17%.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I31</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I32</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Policy and growth outlook:</strong> The RBI has maintained the repo rate at 5.25% while projecting a real GDP growth rate of 6.9% for the current fiscal year.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMivgFBVV95cUxOTGFSNzg0VzlJdnMwYWh2TzliX3libXhnd0pFajdsbW05R3dZU3Y5V3BjRU5uV2Q0aDVOZWZNX3dDdHpvNXpGOXRTQlNnQVRScklzNU5QdjVmV2YzOWlFVWZXMXFSZWxscFJIdFY0UHhleHZreWhkRmhqNGpCeTBYTVlpZ3AxcFN5X0h6SkFqSHJzSTBhWER6N1lkQXB3cnlLRXU4TF95ZjNWdC01XzBkTm0zOGN3RmpXc1lQSkdR?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I30</a></span></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Global Cues</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Macroeconomic triggers:</strong> Market sentiment this week will be primarily steered by the RBI’s policy stance, ongoing Q1 earnings reports, and potential volatility in crude oil prices amid geopolitical tensions in the Middle East.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W11</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Currency and energy impact:</strong> The Indian Rupee has remained relatively stable despite a 20% surge in global crude oil prices, a key factor for investors monitoring import costs and inflation risks.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W13</a></span></li>
</ul>
